scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --dir frontend run test:forms && pnpm --dir frontend run test:i18n && pnpm --dir frontend run test:version && pnpm --dir frontend run test:metrics
scripts.test:frontend:e2e: pnpm --dir frontend run test:e2e && pnpm --dir frontend run test:e2e:live
scripts.test:agent:quality: cd agent && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./...
scripts.dev:preview: pnpm run build && cd backend && pnpm run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend run typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend exec tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:migrations && pnpm run test:modules && pnpm run test:security && pnpm run test:frontend && (cd agent && go test ./...)
scripts.test:all: pnpm run types:worker:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:workers && pnpm run test:frontend:e2e && pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:dry-run && pnpm run test:dependencies && pnpm run test:agent:quality && pnpm run test:agent:smoke && pnpm run test:agent:cross-build && git diff --check
